description: Compute net charge of the filaggrin repeat unit across pH (Henderson-Hasselbalch), highlighting cationicity at stratum corneum pH where His protonates; save summary table/plot
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P20930.fasta",timeout=60).text.splitlines()[1:])
rep=seq[373:428]  # canonical repeat unit example
c=Counter(rep)
pKa={'Nterm':9.0,'Cterm':2.0,'K':10.5,'R':12.5,'H':6.0,'D':3.9,'E':4.1,'C':8.3,'Y':10.1}
def charge(s,pH):
    q=1/(1+10**(pH-pKa['Nterm'])) - 1/(1+10**(pKa['Cterm']-pH))
    for aa,n in Counter(s).items():
        if aa in ('K','R','H'):
            q+= n*(1/(1+10**(pH-pKa[aa])))
        if aa in ('D','E','C','Y'):
            q-= n*(1/(1+10**(pKa[aa]-pH)))
    return q
pHs=np.arange(2,10.01,0.5)
qs=[charge(rep,p) for p in pHs]
for p,q in zip(pHs,qs):
    tag=""
    if abs(p-7.4)<0.01: tag=" <- blood"
    print(f"pH {p:.1f}: net charge {q:+.1f} ({q/len(rep):+.3f}/res)")
print("\nAt SC surface pH ~5.0:", f"{charge(rep,5.0):+.1f}")
print("At pH 7.4:", f"{charge(rep,7.4):+.1f}")
print("At pH 6.0 (His pKa, keratohyalin):", f"{charge(rep,6.0):+.1f}")
print(f"\nRepeat unit n={len(rep)}: His={c['H']} Arg={c['R']} Ser={c['S']} Lys={c['K']} Asp={c['D']} Glu={c['E']}")
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
plt.plot(pHs,qs,'o-'); plt.axhline(0,color='k',lw=.5)
plt.axvspan(4.5,6.0,alpha=.15,color='orange',label='stratum corneum pH')
plt.xlabel('pH'); plt.ylabel('net charge of 55-aa repeat'); plt.title('FLG repeat unit is cationic at skin pH'); plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('flg_charge_vs_pH.png',dpi=110)
print("saved plot")
